rv.q: This quiet master of his craft combines big themes with intimate details garlanded with good jokes...Telling this story of decay, love, persistence and the circle of life, Mike Birbiglia is a true star.
Birbiglia – on a cool blue set tiled to resemble his local swimming pool – plunges into the deep end of mortality, families and the meaning of life.

Drifting in front of a curved set like the tiled bottom of a swimming pool combined with a tidal wave, Birbiglia deftly takes us through a set that sometimes dives deeply but mostly stays splashing in the middle lane.
You will chew over all the details on the way home, and then want to see it all over again.
Birbiglia’s signature style blends observational comedy, storytelling, and life’s big questions.
Like so much about the evening, it’s an acute observation delivered, almost disguised, in a flurry of laughter.
The tone of wry self-mockery did not vary enough in tone or content to sustain a full evening...
The Old Man & The Pool is a really touching piece of theatre, that also manages to be a hilarious night of stand-up.
Mike Birbiglia’s The Man and the Pool is an engaging and truly funny hit of a show.

cn.t: Critics praise Mike Birbiglia's poignant and hilarious storytelling, finding The Old Man & the Pool a masterfully crafted exploration of aging and mortality that balances big themes with intimate details and consistently strong jokes.
